page.overview:
What is Clan Tordarroch Forge?

Clan Tordarroch Forge was the best forge in all the Isles, located on the island of Undvik, and was used by Clan Tordarroch to make the finest weapons. After the Ice Giant awoke from his slumber, he completely wrecked the place and stored all of his food (mostly comprising of human corpses) inside the forge.
